ruleDefinitions.name: Enumeration for 3rd Party Creds From CLI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects processes that query known 3rd party registry keys that holds credentials via commandline

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Aerofox\\\\Foxmail\\\\V3\\\.1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Aerofox\\\\FoxmailPreview.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\DownloadManager\\\\Passwords.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\FTPWare\\\\COREFTP\\\\Sites.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\IncrediMail\\\\Identities.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Martin\\ Prikryl\\\\WinSCP\\ 2\\\\Sessions.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Mobatek\\\\MobaXterm\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\OpenSSH\\\\Agent\\\\Keys.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\OpenVPN\\-GUI\\\\configs.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\ORL\\\\WinVNC3\\\\Password.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Qualcomm\\\\Eudora\\\\CommandLine.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\RealVNC\\\\WinVNC4.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\RimArts\\\\B2\\\\Settings.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\SimonTatham\\\\PuTTY\\\\Sessions.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\SimonTatham\\\\PuTTY\\\\SshHostKeys\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Sota\\\\FFFTP.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\TightVNC\\\\Server.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\WOW6432Node\\\\Radmin\\\\v3\\\.0\\\\Server\\\\Parameters\\\\Radmin.*")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("reg\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*export.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*save.*"))))
